_comment: Corrective base + creative looks. Each look's full ffmpeg filter = base + ',' + chain (base is auto-prepended unless prepend_base:false). RETUNE 'base' per footage from assess.py output: log footage -> put the log->Rec.709 conversion here; already-Rec.709 -> neutralize the WB cast (move signalstats U/V toward 128, but NOT all the way, to keep skin warmth), lift exposure, add mild contrast/saturation. The example base below is tuned for footage with a mild WARM cast + slight underexposure.

looks.name: clean_neutral
looks.label: 1 · CLEAN NEUTRAL
looks.desc: corrected only, true color (the honest reference)

looks.name: warm_filmic
looks.label: 2 · WARM FILMIC
looks.desc: golden highlights, soft film toe, lifted blacks

looks.name: cool_desat
looks.label: 3 · COOL DESAT
looks.desc: modern muted; cools ONLY shadows/highlights to keep skin alive

looks.name: teal_orange
looks.label: 4 · TEAL & ORANGE
looks.desc: cinematic split-tone: teal shadows, warm midtones/skin

looks.name: punchy_vibrant
looks.label: 5 · PUNCHY VIBRANT
looks.desc: high contrast + vibrance (protects skin from over-saturating)

looks.name: vintage_faded
looks.label: 6 · VINTAGE FADED
looks.desc: lifted/faded blacks, low saturation, warm-green tint
